headline: #236 IS TAKEN BUT NOT YET LANDED, and #252 is PROVEN rather than inferred. The snapshot exists and is checksum-verified, but it lives on branch figma-snapshot-236 behind PR #258 — it is NOT on main and #236 stays open until that merges, so check:figma-drift still has no baseline on main. Adrian took the first figma/snapshot.json with the desktop plugin (branch figma-snapshot-236) after it was established that an agent never could: use_figma truncates its response at 20 KB and the real file is 255 KB — 12.8x the cap. check:figma-drift then ran against real state for the first time in the project's history and reports 475 items: 62 missing, 35 extra, 378 changed. It names #252 exactly — `color/surface/page [Dark]` should alias primitive.color.neutral.black and Figma has it on color/neutral/white; `color/content/primary [Dark]` should be neutral.100 and Figma has neutral.900. Figma's Dark mode is literally holding Light's values, so the code model is right and the file was simply never pushed to. The fix is pnpm figma:push, NOT a change to build-figma-model.mjs. Also merged: #255 (squash) — the 35-commit guardrail sweep that everything was stacking on. Two new defects filed from evidence rather than suspicion: #256 (4 of 5 push carriers exceed use_figma's 50,000-char limit) and #257 (Radio animates colour to var() strings framer-motion cannot interpolate, so the transition silently never runs).
next: Open/merge the PR for branch figma-snapshot-236 so figma/snapshot.json lands on main — until it does, check:figma-drift has no committed baseline on main and goes dark again

THE HIGH-LEVERAGE FIGMA-CONSUMABILITY STEP, never run: FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN=<token> pnpm figma:links --dev-resources --dry-run, then without --dry-run. It attaches 'HDS source' and 'HDS story' dev resources to all 44 mapped nodes, and now that storybookUrl is set those point at rendered stories instead of raw GitHub. One command, needs a token with file_dev_resources:read+write

#252's fix is a push, not a patch: pnpm figma:push against staging 2VgBbVpKiDnu0aftJEVyBQ, then re-snapshot and re-run check:figma-drift to confirm Light/Dark separate. Do NOT touch scripts/build-figma-model.mjs — the drift report proves it is already correct

#257 — Radio's colour animation is dead (var() strings passed to framer-motion's animate prop). Fix by driving colour from CSS variants and leaving only `scale` on the animate prop; add a gate, because the only symptom is a stderr warning inside a passing test
#256 — correct figma/README.md and pnpm figma:push's run output to say which carriers fit use_figma's 50,000-char limit (only 04-role and snapshot do), then decide chunk-further vs plugin-only

Drawing the remaining 40 (41 missing minus StatusDot, already drawn) is now fully unblocked: #235 ratified AND the snapshot exists. Order: Tier 1 Icon/Token/Text; Tier 2 the date/time family then the overlays; Tier 3 the rest, StackedCardRail and CinematicLink last

public/hds-manifest.json carries figmaUrl and figmaLink as byte-identical duplicates on all 44 linked components. Dropping one shrinks the published manifest without another budget change, but breaks manifest consumers — needs a call

Smaller items from a full test run, noted in #257 rather than filed: scroll.test.tsx is missing IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT; check-code-connect.test.mjs takes 20.2s of a 31s suite; the disposition test dumps its whole table to stdout mid-run
17 check-tier-bypass violations; recommendation in #242 is 3 semantic families, zIndex named layers first
#249 — gate the record artifacts so status.json and .changeset cannot silently go stale
blocked: FIGMA IS NOT YET CONSUMABLE BY OTHER DESIGNERS, and the first drift run is the evidence. Dark mode is broken (holds Light values); Role (20 vars), Brand (3) and Density (1) do not exist in Figma at all; 41 of 88 library components have no Figma node; 251 `scopes` mismatches mean variables appear in the wrong property pickers; 121 `hiddenFromPublishing` mismatches mean the wrong things are published to the shared library. ALL of that was measured on the STAGING copy — the published library c8MaVgwxOlxm4wr8wnH0Z4 that consumers actually resolve from has never been snapshotted, so its true state is unmeasured

Adrian: Code Connect needs a Figma ORGANIZATION plan. On Pro the v2 templates generate and gate locally but cannot publish, so Dev Mode shows no HDS snippets and designers get no code↔design jump. This is a plan purchase, not a code problem

Adrian: #254 — API right-sizing (core/pattern/fold, patterns subpath, release targets). Still open, needs-decision, default fires 2026-10-03 and the default IS the recommended outcome, so silence resolves it. Untouched. Its '41 folds' is a DIFFERENT 41 from the 41 missing Figma components

Adrian: #126 — CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN in Actions secrets + CHROMATIC_ENABLED=true in Actions variables. Verified this session that the chromatic job green-SKIPS without it (`if: vars.CHROMATIC_ENABLED == 'true'`), so its passing check on #255 meant nothing ran. autoAcceptChanges is already wired for main, so no manual baseline accept will be needed once enabled

Adrian: #199 — release held by an org-level policy, not a repo setting. GitHub org hirobius -> Settings -> Actions -> General -> Workflow permissions -> Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests. Nothing publishes past 0.13.0 until this is ticked

Adrian: two community UI kits (Material 3 Design Kit, Simple Design System) are subscribed to the HDS Figma file, so every design-system search returns their components alongside ours. Figma -> Assets panel -> book icon -> toggle both off

gitleaks is not installed locally, so check:secrets skips on every commit. .gitleaks.toml with the HDS token-path allowlists is already committed, so the gate works the moment the binary is on PATH. HARDENING_ROADMAP #290's bootstrap script would fix this class of gap
resolvedThisSession: #236 CLOSED IN SUBSTANCE — the first figma/snapshot.json exists (255 KB, checksum-verified, 339 variables across 3 collections). Proven along the way that no agent can ever take it: the carrier runs fine and returns a valid checksum, but use_figma truncates its response at 20 KB while --ingest verifies a checksum over the exact bytes. A transport ceiling, not a credential problem. Two earlier failures were misread as transcription error; the runtime was then shown to return function source verbatim and all ten functions to transmit byte-perfect, so the guard was never at fault

#252 PROVEN against real state, with the model checked first as instructed. pnpm figma:model emits 45 of 360 variables differing between Light and Dark; the Figma file has 189 mode-aware variables with EXACTLY 0 differing, and the drift report names the pairs (surface/page [Dark] -> neutral/white instead of neutral/black). Every staging variable also carries path=null, i.e. no hirobius plugin-data key, independently confirming the file has never received a push. Stale file, not a model bug — the two branches of that decision needed opposite fixes

check:figma-drift RAN FOR THE FIRST TIME EVER. 475 items. The important shape: 372 of the 378 'changed' are metadata (251 scopes, 121 hiddenFromPublishing), real value drift is a handful of named tokens, and 27 of the 62 missing are the three collections that do not exist in Figma. Component also carries the wrong mode structure entirely — Figma has Light/Dark where the model says a single Default mode

#255 MERGED to main (squash). The 35-commit guardrail sweep. Gated properly for the first time and green on every CI gate; check:size needed an approved budget re-baseline (47 -> 55 kB, manifest went 120 -> 139 components) and check-tier-bypass stayed red at 16 vs main's 17, pre-existing and not a CI-PR gate

/code-review ran before that PR as CLAUDE.md mandates and found four things, all verified against the tree rather than taken on the reviewer's word. Three fixed: #251 had shipped its option-1 implementation with NO test though its own DoD demands one, and writing that test exposed that importing check-link-integrity.mjs ran the whole gate and called process.exit so the module was not unit-testable at all; `source: 'agent'` was outside SCHEMA.md's declared enum (as was a pre-existing `generated`); fixturePath was null against fixtures the branch itself added

#235 CLOSED, count reconciled: 88 library / 18 slot / 14 layout / 19 internal, libraryMissing 41, so 40 left to draw. The 'stale generatedAt' theory was WRONG — regeneration produced no diff. The 39-vs-41 delta was entirely commit 3f3d51e's three overrides (Frame, OverflowList -> library; Sketch -> internal), flagged in the closing comment so it can be reopened if the integer rather than the rules was what was ratified

#256 filed — 4 of 5 push carriers exceed use_figma's 50,000-char code limit (01-primitive 76 KB, 02-semantic 100 KB, 03-component 67 KB, 05-styles 55 KB). The documented agent push path works for 04-role only

#257 filed — Radio animates backgroundColor/borderColor to var(--semantic-*) strings. framer-motion cannot interpolate those, so the colour transition silently never runs while `scale` in the same object does. Survived #239's rewrite unexamined; the file's own JSDoc documents the broken mechanism as intended

Stale doc-rot fixed: scripts/figma-disposition.mjs said 'PROPOSAL for hds#235 — ratify or redline it' in three places, which after closing #235 sent every future reader to a closed issue. Now states that the RULES were ratified and that corrections go in `overrides`. Counts verified unchanged after the rewrite

figma/links.json storybookUrl set to https://hirobius-design-system.vercel.app and rebaked; figma:links --check green, and the URL now reaches the generated descriptions carrier. A previous session left this undone specifically because it could not run the generator

A use_figma carrier now ships only the runtime it reaches (reachableRuntime). The read-only snapshot no longer carries hdsApply, the code that creates, rewrites and deletes variables: 37,109 -> 6,803 bytes, 25 functions -> 10, with the checksum covering exactly what runs

Environment verified end to end and the three inherited environment blockers cleared: pnpm install works (registry.npmjs.org reachable via the default-package-managers option, NOT the Custom allowlist), pnpm figma:inventory --fetch works, the rotated Figma PAT authenticates

This branch was restarted from main after #255 was SQUASH-merged. main's tip has one parent and 570cdc1 is not an ancestor, so the old branch showed 38 commits against main of which ~33 were content main already had. Only the genuinely unmerged Figma work was replayed: the StatusDot pilot walkthrough, COMPONENT-DRAWING-RECIPE.md, the carrier change and the Storybook link. Four commits of status.json churn were collapsed into this single write
